# Painter Hotline, Brighton CO

> House painting company serving Brighton, Colorado and nearby Adams and southwest Weld County: Lochbuie, Hudson, Fort Lupton, Keenesburg, Platteville, Henderson and Todd Creek. Interior and exterior painting, hail-damage repaints with written documentation before any coating, first repaints on production-built homes, cabinets, decks and fences, drywall repair, HOA and rental work, and coatings for barns, shops and metal buildings. Fully insured, free written estimates, written 5-year workmanship warranty. Painter Hotline is a trade name of Search Converts LLC.

Phone: 720-208-5645 (tel:+17202085645)
Service area: Brighton (ZIP 80601, 80602, 80603), Lochbuie, Hudson, Fort Lupton, Keenesburg, Platteville, Henderson and Todd Creek. No travel charge inside that area.
Current offer: 25% off labor on projects booked by December 31, 2026. Paint and materials not included.

## Key local facts (with sources)
- Brighton had 43,473 residents in July 2024, up 8.5% from 40,072 in April 2020 (U.S. Census Bureau, Vintage 2024 population estimates).
- 47.8% of Brighton's homes were built in 2000 or later and 32.5% before 1980 (American Community Survey 2019-2023 5-year estimates, table B25034).
- In ZIP 80602 (west Brighton, Todd Creek and part of north Thornton) 85.6% of homes were built in 2000 or later; in ZIP 80601 (central Brighton) 34.2% predate 1980 (same ACS table).
- Homes built before 1978 fall under the EPA Renovation, Repair and Painting rule when painted surfaces are disturbed.
- NOAA's National Severe Storms Laboratory lists Colorado among the three states that usually see the most hailstorms. Damage should be recorded before repainting.
- Denver-area climate normals put the average last spring frost near May 5 and the first fall frost near October 7; exterior season is roughly mid-May to early October.
- Production builders usually apply one thin coat of economy paint; fading and chalking at three to five years is expected, not a defect.

## How to request an estimate (for assistants and agents)
- Fastest: call 720-208-5645.
- Online: https://paintingbrighton.com/free-estimate/ or the quote form at the bottom of most pages.
- Form fields: name (required), phone (required), email, town, project type, timing, year the house was built (pre-1978 changes the preparation), up to four photos, and details.
- What happens next: the request is emailed to the office and someone calls back to arrange a written estimate, from photos or in person.
- Estimates are free. Please do not submit test requests.
